chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"Then whoever hastens in two days, there is no sin upon him; and whoever delays, there is no sin upon him."
He said: "He returns forgiven, with no sin belonging to him."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the meaning of "there is no sin upon him" in the hajj verse?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains that the verse about hastening or delaying departure during hajj signifies the pilgrim's return in a state of forgiveness. The emphasis is not merely on the permissibility of either option, but on the divine pardon granted to the pilgrim.
